# Command

A search-first menu of actions and places, opened from the keyboard.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill odv-pill-out">Left out of Content first</span> Command suits expert users who type to jump anywhere. Most readers visit now and then, and the catalogue rules it out for them. <span class="odv-instead">Use instead: <a href="./navigation-menu">Navigation menu</a>, <a href="./input">Input</a></span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-command--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:content-first;mode:light" title="Command examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-command--docs">Open Command in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-command--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:content-first;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Expert users who want to jump anywhere or run any action by typing.
- **Not when:** The only way to reach an action, or people who visit now and then.

Instead:

- [Dropdown menu](./dropdown-menu.md): A short menu from a button.
- [Combobox](./combobox.md): Picking a value for a field.

## Words

- Write to one person: "you", not "users".
- Short sentences with room to breathe.
- Explain why before asking for anything.
- Use: Read, Save for later, You, Next issue. Avoid: Click here, Submit, Users, Content.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Browse guides

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | A shortcut opens it; arrows move; Enter runs; Escape closes. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Results are a list; the active result is announced. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add command
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Command reads 41 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Command's tokens to change Command alone.
